This graph shows the portion of North America (not including Greenland) covered by snow, averaged over the entire year. Historical observations are from 1981 through 2023. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios are from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1950 to 2014. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Shaded bands show the range of unsmoothed annual values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
